concepts.name: population
value: ECU software systems and their executable test artifacts (ECU test scripts)

value: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for generating executable ECU test scripts

concepts.name: comparison
value: Manually authored executable ECU test scripts by ECU test engineers

concepts.name: outcome
value: Reduction in test-spec/script authoring time and effort
Quality improvements of generated test scripts (e.g., fault-detection effectiveness, requirement coverage, correctness/validity, adherence to ECU test standards)
Improved maintainability or consistency of test scripts

value: Automotive embedded software testing environments (ECU testing), including safety/reliability-driven industrial settings where traceability to requirements and compliance matter
